value.rationale: The 2024 founder and 2026 research article identify determination of spider cooling as a natural problem. The theorem gives a sharp complete two-parameter mixed-arm family and detects the previously uncovered three-long/two-short transition and an exceptional three-long/one-short obstruction. This structural maximality boundary has use beyond a mere small-instance numerical census.
